guardrails: Requires BNA_ONETIME_CRM_TEST_DATABASE_URL; production DATABASE_URL is intentionally ignored.
Refuses remote-looking database URLs unless BNA_ALLOW_REMOTE_ONETIME_CRM_TEST_DB=1 is set for an approved test database.
Allows Railway-hosted test databases only when BNA_ALLOW_RAILWAY_ONETIME_CRM_TEST_DB=1 and BNA_ONETIME_CRM_TEST_RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT names a test-like environment.
Uses only TEST/example.invalid data and deletes seeded local/test rows in cleanup.
No email, WhatsApp, payment, access grant, import, or external CRM write is performed.

steps.name: wait for required CRM schema bootstrap
seed local/test One Time CRM records
edit contact and assign follow-up through CRM API
reload confirms persisted edit and follow-up task
targeted timeline contains note and follow-up task
cross-workspace CRM list does not leak seeded contact
open targeted mailbox and return with selected contact restored
